title: La Paloma - printed piano right hand
scope: One pass of the upper piano staff through the final fermata, aligned with the printed lower staff. The closing D.C. for additional stanzas is a separate performance choice.
editorial: Preview tempo is an editorial quarter-note 88 BPM. The fermata keeps its nominal value. Engraved ties join identical pitches, while slurs across changing pitches are treated as phrasing.
Each unmeasured pair of ornamental sixteenths occupies two ticks per note at the start of the following written value. The ornaments are present on printed p. 2 systems 1–4 and p. 3 systems 1–2.

On p. 3 system 4 bar 6 and p. 4 systems 1–3, the upper piano beaming and parallel canto guide the use of triplet eighths where the engraved values overrun the bar. On p. 4 system 3 bar 1 the double-dotted triplet eighth occupies 14 ticks and the short third note occupies two.

In the low coda, the right hand follows the piano beams independently of the canto. This includes the second system on p. 5, where the three repeated B3 sixteenths in the right hand are separate attacks.
